d: Congress Parliamentary Party Chairperson Sonia Gandhi addressed the launch of her memoir, 'Belonging: A Journey of Love,' published by HarperCollins, reflecting on six decades of her personal and political life in India. Gandhi explained that persistent fabrications and claims regarding her family prompted her to document her story. Explaining the title, she detailed her adjustment as an outsider entering the Nehru-Gandhi household, drawing parallels to the experiences of Indian women entering matrimonial homes.
